# MN Lakes
```{r}
mn_data <- open_dataset(sources = file.path("G:",
                                            "Shared drives",
                                            "Hansen Lab",
                                            "RESEARCH PROJECTS",
                                            "Fish Survey Data",
                                            "Parquet files",
                                            "mn_update")) 
names(mn_data)

mn_lakes <- mn_data %>% 
  select(lake_id, nhdhr_id, latitude_lake_centroid, longitude_lake_centroid) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(latitude_lake_centroid)) %>% 
  distinct(lake_id, nhdhr_id, latitude_lake_centroid, longitude_lake_centroid) %>% 
  collect()

mn_lakes %>% 
  group_by(nhdhr_id) %>% 
  summarise(n_lat_lon = n_distinct(latitude_lake_centroid, longitude_lake_centroid)) %>% 
  filter(n_lat_lon >1)

mn_lakes %>% 
  filter(nhdhr_id %in% c("nhdhr_120019424", "nhdhr_34123413", "nhdhr_34243896", "nhdhr_80996157", "nhdhr_86272945")) %>% 
  arrange(nhdhr_id, lake_id, latitude_lake_centroid, longitude_lake_centroid)
#mn lakes with a lat/lon with lake id and nhdhr
#we see that some cases have multpule lake ids within an nhdhr - not unexpected and generally "unique" systems 
rm(mn_data)

lakes_vect <- vect(mn_lakes,
                   geom = c("longitude_lake_centroid",
                            "latitude_lake_centroid"),
                   crs = "EPSG:4326")
```

# trial reading in data from URL
```{r}
extract_month_remote <- function(year,
                                 month,
                                 lakes_vect,
                                 lake_ids) {

  url <- paste0(
    "https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/data/nclimgrid-daily/access/grids/",
    year,
    "/ncdd-",
    year,
    sprintf("%02d", month),
    "-grd-scaled.nc"
  )

  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".nc")

  on.exit({
    if (file.exists(tmp)) unlink(tmp)
  }, add = TRUE)

  download.file(
    url,
    destfile = tmp,
    mode = "wb",
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  s <- sds(tmp)

  dates <- as.Date(time(s[["tmax"]]))

  make_long <- function(rast_obj, prefix, value_name) {

    extract(rast_obj, lakes_vect) |>
      mutate(lake_id = lake_ids) |>
      select(-ID) |>
      pivot_longer(
        -lake_id,
        names_to = "layer",
        values_to = value_name
      ) |>
      mutate(
        day_num = as.integer(
          gsub(paste0(prefix, "_"), "", layer)
        ),
        date = dates[day_num]
      ) |>
      select(-layer, -day_num)
  }

  tmax_long <- make_long(
    s[["tmax"]],
    "tmax",
    "tmax"
  )

  tmin_long <- make_long(
    s[["tmin"]],
    "tmin",
    "tmin"
  )

  prcp_long <- make_long(
    s[["prcp"]],
    "prcp",
    "prcp"
  )

  tavg_long <- make_long(
    s[["tavg"]],
    "tavg",
    "tavg"
  )

  tmax_long |>
    left_join(tmin_long,
              by = c("lake_id", "date")) |>
    left_join(prcp_long,
              by = c("lake_id", "date")) |>
    left_join(tavg_long,
              by = c("lake_id", "date")) |>
    mutate(
      year = year(date),
      doy = yday(date)
    )
}

process_year <- function(year,
                         lakes_vect,
                         lake_ids) {

  map_dfr(
    1:12,
    \(m) extract_month_remote(
      year = year,
      month = m,
      lakes_vect = lakes_vect,
      lake_ids = lake_ids
    )
  )
}

clim_2024 <- process_year(
  year = 2024,
  lakes_vect = lakes_vect,
  lake_ids = mn_lakes$lake_id
)
```

# full go
```{r}
extract_month <- function(file, lakes_vect, lake_ids) {

  s <- sds(file)

  dates <- as.Date(time(s[["tmax"]]))

  tmax <- extract(s[["tmax"]], lakes_vect)
  tmin <- extract(s[["tmin"]], lakes_vect)

  tmax_long <- tmax |>
  mutate(lake_id = lake_ids) |>
  select(-ID) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -lake_id,
    names_to = "layer",
    values_to = "tmax"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    day_num = as.integer(gsub("tmax_", "", layer)),
    date = dates[day_num]
  ) |>
  select(-layer, -day_num)

  tmin_long <- tmin |>
  mutate(lake_id = lake_ids) |>
  select(-ID) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -lake_id,
    names_to = "layer",
    values_to = "tmin"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    day_num = as.integer(gsub("tmin_", "", layer)),
    date = dates[day_num]
  ) |>
  select(-layer, -day_num)


  out <- tmax_long |>
  left_join(
    tmin_long,
    by = c("lake_id", "date")
  )

  out
}

clim_2024 <- map_dfr(
  files,
  extract_month,
  lakes_vect = lakes_vect,
  lake_ids = mn_lakes$lake_id
) %>% 
  mutate(
    tmean = (tmax + tmin) / 2,
    gdd5 = pmax(tmean - 5, 0),
    gdd10 = pmax(tmean - 10, 0)
  ) %>% 
   arrange(lake_id, date) |>
  group_by(lake_id, year = lubridate::year(date)) |>
  mutate(
    gdd5_cum = cumsum(gdd5),
    gdd10_cum = cumsum(gdd10)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

clim_2024 %>% 
  filter(lake_id == "10000200") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(date, gdd5_cum), color = "blue") +
  geom_point(aes(date, gdd10_cum), color = "orange")
  
```
